text:
maria: quick async check-in — SLO/alert follow-up

maria: what I did: triaged the EU-west 5xx spike, rolled back a small batcher change, ran `kubectl rollout undo` on the embedding-worker deploy, and created ticket #3452 with logs.
blocker: still seeing intermittent kv-evict alert flaps; not sure if it's eviction cadence or routing jitter.
today: will run a short-lived canary with increased warmup, pair with jonathan to tune the alert rule.

jonathan: saw the same spike. logs look like cold starts + kv misses. happy to shadow the canary. i can also open a quick PR to relax the alert debounce.

kai: +1 on increasing debounce. 30s is noisy; propose 2m as a temporary override. won't stop us from surfacing real regressions.

sam: oncall-bot shows 3 pages from kv-evict in the last hour. i'm fine with 2m but add a compound condition so we don't suppress real issues (eg. rate > 5 and p50 latency > 200ms).

maria: pairing at 11:30 PT works. jonathan, can you open the toggle PR? here's a snippet i'm thinking we can use as a starting point:
```yaml
alert: KVCacheEvictHigh
expr: (rate(kv_evicts[5m]) > 5) and (histogram_quantile(0.5, kv_latency_bucket) > 0.2)
for: 2m
```

jonathan: will open PR and drop the link here when ready. i'll also kick off a synthetic run after canary to validate. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: incident created #SRE-892 — notify: sam, maria, jonathan

maria: please ack if you're watching the canary; i'll post results and follow-up actions.

kai: ack — i'll monitor alert noise and be ready to revert the debounce if we miss anything obvious.

sam: ack. if stable after two canary cycles i'll close the incident.

maria: thanks team — short and practical today. will post results in ~40m.
